The accessibility is atrocious.
Fill out a form between 8-11 on a weekday(impossible for me as I have a busy dental clinic) or try again from 1:30(impossible again as this is lunch/admin time).
You call them and reception are rude and dismissive. ‘Fill out the form- whenever you explain that you can’t they reluctantly fill it in for you.’
There is no where on the website to escalate dissatisfaction- odd since they are so ‘high tech’ otherwise during the hours of 8&11 and again at 1:30pm.
Perhaps these magically appear on the website on these hours.
There is no email depicted in which we ca write to staff. The entire process is opaque and setting the patient up for failure. NBevan would be turning in his grave is he seen that this is what our NHS has been reduced to.

Furthermore apparently if you are pregnant they don’t want to know- reception-“the midwives will be in contact, they will take care of you.”
No congratulations, not explanation of care division, my needs, expectations. Nothing.
It’s either ‘comply or goodbye.’

It’s simply put not a good surgery for working mothers. Particularly and ironically if you work in healthcare. Unless you have an emergency.
The entire booking system and accessibility is set up so as urgent care is easy and routine cumbersome.
Must affect their stats in a positive way.
I would avoid this surgery if you want any regular easy run of the mill care. No accountability, ease of access, nor clear complaints policy.
They are due a CQC Inspection soon- get it together guys!",null,[0,146]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsUFZGUmxjMFJPTVU1Q2FDMUljVUY2UVdkWmJHYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x1fa39f5fd4937706!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOllPVFRlc0ROMU5CaC1IcUF6QWdZbGc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsUFZGUmxjMFJPTVU1Q2FDMUljVUY2UVdkWmJHYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi8mZzl0bOTAxUXL2MBHdHxD3EQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi8mZzl0bOTAxUXL2MBHdHxD3EQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUJ6ZDNGWldsOWZSV2hDWDNadFVGRmtMUzFUZVZWMWVYcHpjMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSWTBOWkxYcERjR2hyV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kMVlXUkxUa3A0VkhsV01tRjRPR2xWVnpCTVQyYxAB",["0x0:0x1fa39f5fd4937706",null,1767687449455862,1767687449455862,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/108966235829818566640/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["sabina mazzacurati","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJbjNpE9O_yC5E2Up9QaDvoG1nFDv0kLVH8O7wUtJayzoF2TuL8=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/108966235829818566640?hl=en"],"108966235829818566640",null,6,4,null,[0,3,1],1,["6 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi8mZzl0bOTAxUXL2MBHdHxD3EQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I had very bad experiences.....sometimes it happens to see a good gp bur very rarely.

been a patient at Trumpington Medical Practice for years and have always felt supported by almost every GP here. Unfortunately, my recent appointment with Dr Parker was very different.

I’m under a consultant psychiatrist for chronic insomnia and take a Class C medication exactly as prescribed.

Dr Parker: Criticised me for “still” taking the medication and asked why I couldn’t just stop, disregarding my specialist’s plan.
Suggested I “have a drink” (alcohol) instead because “it works on the same pathway.”
